description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between the number of tokens and the performance of different code retrieval methods, including Tutorials, Library Documentation, Github files, and a baseline method. The x-axis, labeled "Number of Tokens," is linear and ranges from 200 to 900 tokens. The y-axis, labeled "Performance," is also linear and ranges from 10 to 40. The Tutorials line, represented by a blue line with circular markers, starts at approximately 25 on the y-axis and ends at around 30, showing a slight increase. The Library Documentation line, in red, begins at about 20 and ends near 30, indicating a moderate increase. The Github files line, in green, starts at around 30 and ends at approximately 35, showing a slight increase. The baseline line, in yellow, begins at about 10 and ends at around 20, indicating a moderate increase. The plot does not include any section titles or annotations beyond the description of the lines.
